title.narrative: Housing for Integrated Rural Development Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative:
The Program will help to strengthen the impact of the government's Rural Development Program (RDP) and Rural Housing Scheme (RHS) to improve rural livelihoods and living standards, including better coordination with the government's financial sector strategy and new Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME) Program. In the medium term, the MFF supports (i) access to affordable housing finance and housing (ii) improved local government capacity to implement integrated rural development strategies that focus on creating rural jobs; and (iii) strengthening the enabling environment for rural MSMEs.
Under the government's roadmap, inclusive rural economic growth will be supported through creation of direct and indirect jobs and other livelihood opportunities, expanded access to affordable housing finance, new improved housing and associated infrastructure and social services, and MSME development.

description.narrative: Downstreaming of rural housing scheme for moderate and lower income beneficiaries, with a focus on women

Increased demand by targeted beneficiaries for housing loans under the scheme from 10,000 in 2009, to 12,000 in 2011, and to 15,000 applicants in 2012 (gender disaggregated) Progress/Status: For HIRD 2012 - 25,000 applications received and processed, exceeding 15,000 targeted Data Source: QQB reports Actual value:

Adoption of defined beneficiary selection criteria, and improved public awareness campaign, grievance process, and monitoring framework Progress/Status: (i) HIRD beneficiary prioritization criteria based on national and regional development priorities prepared (Dec 2011) and adopted (Jan 2012) (iia) HIRD 2012 outreach and public awareness events delivered nationwide (Sep-Dec 2011, and Jan-Mar 2012) (iib)HIRD 2013 major multimedia public information campaign (TV, radio, newspaper, public outreach events) launched nationwide (Oct 2012) (iii) Design of nationwide public redress process requested by government (Oct 2012) (iv) Design of Results-Based Performance and Monitoring Process initiated (Nov 2011), Tranche 1 Performance report being prepared with finalization targeted for Feb 2013 Data Source: Government resolution Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N

Implementation started in Jan 13. Data Source: Specialized project reports submitted by EA to ADB Actual value:
